g.text: Cap charges to V_peak on each pulse, then droops linearly through the load between pulses. Sawtooth ripple on a near-DC level.

g.text: Approximate ST-70 voltages. Ripple amplitudes are exaggerated so the shape of each stage is clearly visible.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Inter', 'system-ui', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: ST-70 chain: 5AR4 cathode → first filter cap → choke → second filter cap → tube plates.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'system-ui', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #777777

g.text: Real ST-70 first-cap droop is ~5–10 V (not 100 V as shown); B+ ripple at the tube plates is under 1 V.
